name: collapsible
title: Collapsible
description: Show and hide in place, on its own: a row with a summary and the set's chevron, a ghost key, or "Show 3 more" on the drum. The panel is uncovered from its top edge as it slides out on the settle spring while what follows travels in step; it slides back on release. Never animates height.
docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/collapsible.md. SwiftUI: MetalCollapsible in the MetalUI Swift package.
